subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: From which part of the thousand-legged Supreme Being were the kshatriyas created, for the protection of the brahmanas?

options.B: His face

explanation: "The thousand-legged Supreme Being created us, the kṣatriyas, from His thousand arms." (SB 3.22.3)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Manu says the brahmanas are said to be the Lord's heart and the kshatriyas are said to be His what?

options.B: Eyes

explanation: "Hence the brāhmaṇas are said to be His heart and the kṣatriyas His arms." (SB 3.22.3)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Of which two sons of Manu is Devahuti the sister?

options.B: Priyavrata and Uttanapada

explanation: "My daughter is the sister of Priyavrata and Uttānapāda." (SB 3.22.9)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: From which sage had Devahuti heard of Kardama's noble character, learning and virtues, fixing her mind upon him?

options.B: Maitreya

explanation: "The moment she heard from the sage Nārada of your noble character, learning, beautiful appearance, youth and other virtues, she fixed her mind upon you." (SB 3.22.10)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Kardama said that the Vedic marriage could take place because Manu's daughter had not yet done what?

options.B: Taken a vow
options.C: Married or given her word to anyone

explanation: "Your daughter has not yet married or given her word to anyone. Therefore our marriage according to the Vedic system can take place." (SB 3.22.15)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Which great Gandharva fell from his airplane after seeing Devahuti playing with a ball on the palace roof?

options.B: Citraketu

explanation: "I have heard that Viśvāvasu, the great Gandharva... fell from his airplane after seeing your daughter playing with a ball on the roof of the palace." (SB 3.22.17)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: What condition did Kardama place before agreeing to marry Devahuti?

options.A: That he would never have children
options.B: That after she bears semen from his body, he would accept the life of devotional service
options.C: That she must remain a celibate ascetic
options.D: That they would always live in a palace

explanation: "On the condition that after she bears semen from my body, I shall accept the life of devotional service accepted by the most perfect human beings." (SB 3.22.19)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Whom did Kardama name as the highest authority for him, the origin of all the Prajapatis?

options.B: Svayambhuva Manu
options.C: The unlimited Supreme Personality of Godhead

explanation: "The highest authority for me is the unlimited Supreme Personality of Godhead... He is the origin of all Prajāpatis." (SB 3.22.20)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Upon whom was the sage Kardama thinking when he became silent, his lotus-navel-bearing worshipable Lord?

options.B: Lord Visnu

explanation: "The sage Kardama said this much only and then became silent, thinking of his worshipable Lord Viṣṇu, who has a lotus on His navel." (SB 3.22.21)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Whose decision did the Emperor learn before gladly giving his daughter to Kardama, besides Devahuti's own?

options.B: The Queen's

explanation: "After having unmistakably known the decision of the Queen, as well as that of Devahūti, the Emperor most gladly gave his daughter to the sage." (SB 3.22.22)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Who lovingly gave the bride and bridegroom valuable presents such as jewelry, clothes and household articles in dowry?

options.B: Lord Brahma

explanation: "Empress Śatarūpā lovingly gave most valuable presents... in dowry to the bride and bridegroom." (SB 3.22.23)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: How did Svayambhuva Manu react after handing over his daughter to Kardama?

options.B: His mind was agitated by feelings of separation and he embraced her

explanation: "His mind agitated by feelings of separation, embraced his affectionate daughter with both his arms." (SB 3.22.24)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: As tears poured from Manu's eyes upon separation, what did he cry out?

options.B: "My dear mother! My dear daughter!"

explanation: "As he cried, 'My dear mother! My dear daughter!'" (SB 3.22.25)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: From which place did Manu's subjects come forth to greet their returning lord with songs and music?

options.B: Brahmavarta

explanation: "His subjects came forth from Brahmāvarta to greet their returning lord with songs, prayers and musical instruments." (SB 3.22.28)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Upon entering which city did Manu return to his palace, where he had previously lived?

options.B: Hastinapura

explanation: "Having entered the city of Barhiṣmatī, in which he had previously lived, Manu entered his palace." (SB 3.22.32)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Although absorbed in material happiness, why was Svayambhuva Manu not dragged to the lowest grade of life?

options.B: Because he enjoyed his happiness in a Krsna conscious atmosphere
options.D: Because he lived in the forest

explanation: "He always enjoyed his material happiness in a Kṛṣṇa conscious atmosphere." (SB 3.22.34)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: For how many cycles of the four ages did Svayambhuva Manu pass his time, always thinking of Vasudeva?

options.B: Thirty-seven

explanation: "He passed his time, which lasted seventy-one cycles of the four ages... always thinking of Vāsudeva." (SB 3.22.36)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Out of compassion for all living entities, what did Svayambhuva Manu teach in reply to questions asked by certain sages?

options.B: The diverse sacred duties of men and the different varnas and asramas

explanation: "He... taught the diverse sacred duties of men in general and the different varṇas and āśramas." (SB 3.22.38)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: After describing Svayambhuva Manu, whose flourishing does Maitreya say he will next speak of?

options.B: Kardama

explanation: "Please hear as I speak of the flourishing of his daughter Devahūti." (SB 3.22.39)

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Devahuti had heard about Kardama Muni from ———— and had thus fixed her mind on Kardama Muni.

options.B: Her father

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Hiranyaksha attacked the Lord by ____________.

options.A: Throwing a mace against the Lord
options.B: Hurling his trident towards the Lord
options.C: Striking his fist on the Lord's chest

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: The condition which Kardama Muni placed before agreeing for his marriage with Devahuti was ______.

options.A: He would not bear any children in his wife's womb
options.B: Every year he would have a new wife
options.C: After she gets children from him, he would accept a life of devotional service
options.D: They would always live as ascetics

subtopic: Ch 22: The Marriage of Kardama Muni and Devahuti
question: Svayambhuva Manu lived for ————— cycles of the 4 ages completely engaged in matters regarding Vaasudeva.
After her parents departed, Devahuti served her husband constantly with great love, like which goddess serving Lord Siva?

options.B: Bhavani

explanation: "The chaste woman Devahūti... served him constantly with great love, as Bhavānī, the wife of Lord Śiva, serves her husband." (SB 3.23.1)

question: What did Devahuti give up while sanely and diligently pleasing her powerful husband?

options.B: Lust, pride, envy, greed, sinful activities and vanity

explanation: "Giving up all lust, pride, envy, greed, sinful activities and vanity." (SB 3.23.3)

question: Why was Kardama Muni astonished with Devahuti, expressing his pleasure with her?

options.A: She had neglected her own body to use it on his behalf
options.B: She had abandoned her family

explanation: "I am astonished that you have neglected your own body to use it on my behalf." (SB 3.23.6)

question: Kardama said all material achievements are subject to be annihilated simply by what movement of Lord Visnu?

options.B: A movement of His eyebrows

explanation: "All material achievements are subject to be annihilated simply by a movement of the eyebrows of Lord Viṣṇu." (SB 3.23.8)

question: Under whose protection did Devahuti acknowledge Kardama had achieved perfection and mastery of mystic powers?

options.B: Yoga-maya, the transcendental nature

explanation: "You are the master of all the infallible mystic powers because you are under the protection of yoga-māyā, the transcendental nature." (SB 3.23.10)

question: What did Devahuti remind Kardama he had promised, requesting he fulfill it?

options.B: Their bodily union, since children are a great quality for a chaste woman

explanation: "You once made a promise that our bodily union should now fulfill, since children are a great quality for a chaste woman who has a glorious husband." (SB 3.23.10)

question: By what means did Kardama instantly produce an aerial mansion to please Devahuti?

options.B: By the gift of Lord Brahma

explanation: "The sage Kardama exercised his yogic power and instantly produced an aerial mansion that could travel at his will." (SB 3.23.12)

question: In how many stories were the beds, couches, fans and seats of the aerial palace arranged?

options.B: Five

explanation: "The palace looked charming, with beds, couches, fans and seats, all separately arranged in seven stories." (SB 3.23.16)

question: Why did the real swans in the palace repeatedly rise above the artificial swans and pigeons?

options.B: The artificial birds were so lifelike that the real ones thought them live birds

explanation: "Artificial swans and pigeons so lifelike that the real swans rose above them again and again, thinking them live birds like themselves." (SB 3.23.20)

question: Before mounting the aerial mansion, in which lake did Kardama tell Devahuti to bathe?

options.B: Bindu-sarovara

explanation: "First bathe in Lake Bindu-sarovara, created by Lord Viṣṇu Himself, which can grant all the desires of a human being." (SB 3.23.23)

question: How many girls in the prime of youth did Devahuti see in a house inside the lake?

options.B: Five hundred

explanation: "In a house inside the lake she saw one thousand girls, all in the prime of youth and fragrant like lotuses." (SB 3.23.26)

question: What did the damsels say to Devahuti when they suddenly rose with folded hands?

options.B: "We are goddesses of fortune"

explanation: "'We are your maidservants. Tell us what we can do for you.'" (SB 3.23.27)

question: What sweet inebriating drink did the maidservants offer Devahuti along with food of all good qualities?

options.B: Asavam

explanation: "Next they offered her food containing all good qualities, and a sweet inebriating drink called āsavam." (SB 3.23.29)

question: When Devahuti, transformed, thought of her husband, where did she appear?

options.B: At once where Kardama was, along with all the maidservants

explanation: "She, along with all the maidservants, at once appeared where he was." (SB 3.23.34)

question: In the aerial mansion, Kardama with his consort is compared to the moon in the midst of what?

options.B: Stars

explanation: "Kardama Muni with his consort shone as charmingly as the moon in the midst of the stars in the sky." (SB 3.23.38)

question: To the pleasure valleys of which mountain, where Kuvera generally enjoys, did Kardama travel in the aerial mansion?

options.B: Mount Mandara

explanation: "In that aerial mansion he traveled to the pleasure valleys of Mount Meru." (SB 3.23.39)

question: Into how many personalities did Kardama divide himself to give pleasure to Devahuti?

options.B: Seven

explanation: "He divided himself into nine personalities just to give pleasure to Devahūti." (SB 3.23.44)

question: How many female children did Devahuti give birth to, immediately, on the same day?

options.B: Nine

explanation: "Devahūti gave birth to nine female children, all charming in every limb and fragrant with the scent of the red lotus flower." (SB 3.23.48)

question: Besides fulfilling all his promises, what did Devahuti ask Kardama to give her as she was his surrendered soul?

options.B: Fearlessness
options.D: A new husband for her daughters

explanation: "You should give me fearlessness too." (SB 3.23.51)

question: Devahuti laments that anyone whose work, religion and renunciation do not lead to devotional service must be considered what?

options.B: Dead, although breathing

explanation: "Must be considered dead, although he is breathing." (SB 3.23.56)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Whose words did Kardama recall as he replied to Devahuti's words full of renunciation?

options.B: Lord Visnu

explanation: "Recalling the words of Lord Viṣṇu, the merciful sage Kardama replied as follows." (SB 3.24.1)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: What did Kardama tell Devahuti the infallible Supreme Personality of Godhead would shortly do?

options.B: Enter her womb as her son

explanation: "The infallible Supreme Personality of Godhead will shortly enter your womb as your son." (SB 3.24.2)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: According to Kardama, the Lord will vanquish the knot of Devahuti's heart by becoming her son and teaching knowledge of what?

options.B: Karma

explanation: "He will vanquish the knot of your heart by becoming your son and teaching knowledge of Brahman." (SB 3.24.4)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: How did the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Madhusudana, appear in Devahuti, having entered the semen of Kardama?

options.A: Just as light comes from the sun
options.B: Just as fire comes from wood in a sacrifice
options.C: Just as a river flows to the sea

explanation: "Appeared in Devahūti just as fire comes from wood in a sacrifice." (SB 3.24.6)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Who came along with Marichi and other sages to Kardama's hermitage at the Lord's appearance?

options.B: Lord Brahma

explanation: "The first-born living being, went along with Marīci and other sages to the place of Kardama's hermitage." (SB 3.24.9)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Brahma understood the Lord had appeared in Devahuti's womb to explain which system of knowledge?

options.B: Hatha-yoga

explanation: "Had appeared in the womb of Devahūti just to explain the complete state of knowledge known as sāṅkhya-yoga." (SB 3.24.10)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Brahma said sons ought to obey the command of a father or spiritual master with due deference, saying what?

options.B: "Yes, sir"

explanation: "One should obey the command of his father or spiritual master with due deference, saying, 'Yes, sir.'" (SB 3.24.13)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Brahma instructed Kardama to give away his nine daughters to whom?

options.B: The foremost of the sages

explanation: "Today please give away your daughters to the foremost of the sages." (SB 3.24.15)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Brahma told Kardama the Supreme Personality of Godhead had assumed the body of which Muni?

options.B: Kapila

explanation: "He has now assumed the body of Kapila Muni." (SB 3.24.16)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: By what physical feature is Kapila Muni characterized, as described by Brahma?

options.B: His golden hair

explanation: "Kapila Muni, who is characterized by His golden hair, His eyes just like lotus petals." (SB 3.24.17)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Which demon does Brahma say the Supreme Lord, now within Devahuti's womb, had killed?

options.B: Kaitabha

explanation: "The same Supreme Personality of Godhead who killed the demon Kaiṭabha is now within your womb." (SB 3.24.18)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: By what name will Devahuti's son be celebrated among the people, as the head of all perfected souls?

options.B: Kapila

explanation: "Among the people He will be celebrated by the name Kapila." (SB 3.24.19)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: On what carrier did Lord Brahma, also known as Hamsa, return to the highest planetary system?

options.B: Garuda

explanation: "Lord Brahmā... went back to the highest of the three planetary systems on his swan carrier with the four Kumāras and Nārada." (SB 3.24.20)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: After Brahma's departure, to whom did Kardama hand over his nine daughters?

options.B: The nine great sages who created the population of the world

explanation: "Kardama Muni... handed over his nine daughters, as instructed, to the nine great sages who created the population of the world." (SB 3.24.21)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: To which sage did Kardama deliver his daughter Santi, because of whom sacrificial ceremonies are well performed?

options.B: Atri

explanation: "He delivered Śānti to Atharvā. Because of Śānti, sacrificial ceremonies are well performed." (SB 3.24.24)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: What order of life did Kardama wish to accept, having been liberated by the Lord from his debts to his father?

options.B: The order of an itinerant mendicant

explanation: "I wish to accept the order of an itinerant mendicant." (SB 3.24.34)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: The Personality of Godhead Kapila said His appearance was especially to explain which philosophy?

options.B: Sankhya

explanation: "My appearance in this world is especially to explain the philosophy of Sāṅkhya." (SB 3.24.36)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Kapila said this path of self-realization had now been lost in the course of what?

options.B: Time

explanation: "This path of self-realization, which is difficult to understand, has now been lost in the course of time." (SB 3.24.37)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: To whom did Kapila say He would also describe this sublime knowledge so she could attain perfection?

options.B: The sages

explanation: "I shall also describe this sublime knowledge, which is the door to spiritual life, to My mother." (SB 3.24.40)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: After being spoken to by his son Kapila, what vow did Kardama accept as he left for the forest?

options.B: Silence

explanation: "The sage Kardama accepted silence as a vow in order to think of the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.24.42)

subtopic: Ch 24: The Renunciation of Kardama Muni
question: Freed from all hatred and desire, what did Kardama Muni ultimately attain?

options.B: Mystic perfections

explanation: "Kardama Muni... ultimately attained the path back to Godhead." (SB 3.24.47)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Although He is unborn, by what means did the Supreme Personality of Godhead take birth as Kapila Muni?

options.B: By His internal potency
options.C: By the power of the sages

explanation: "Although He is unborn, the Supreme Personality of Godhead took birth as Kapila Muni by His internal potency." (SB 3.25.1)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: For what purpose did Kapila descend?

options.A: To disseminate transcendental knowledge for the benefit of the whole human race
options.B: To kill demons

explanation: "He descended to disseminate transcendental knowledge for the benefit of the whole human race." (SB 3.25.1)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: After Kardama left for the forest, why did Lord Kapila stay at the Bindu-sarovara?

options.B: To please His mother, Devahuti

explanation: "Lord Kapila stayed on the strand of the Bindu-sarovara to please His mother, Devahuti." (SB 3.25.5)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Why did Devahuti say she had fallen into the abyss of ignorance?

options.B: Because of the disturbance caused by her material senses
options.D: Because she had no spiritual master

explanation: "I am very sick of the disturbance caused by my material senses, for because of this sense disturbance, my Lord, I have fallen into the abyss of ignorance." (SB 3.25.7)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Devahuti describes the Lord as which instrument that can cut the tree of material existence?

options.B: An ax

explanation: "You are the ax which can cut the tree of material existence." (SB 3.25.11)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Why did Lord Kapila explain the path of the transcendentalists to His mother?

options.A: He was very keen to deliver her
options.B: It was a duty toward His mother
options.C: She had uncontaminated desire for transcendental realization

explanation: "After hearing of His mother's uncontaminated desire for transcendental realization, the Lord thanked her within Himself for her questions." (SB 3.25.12)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: According to Kapila, when consciousness is attracted by the three modes of material nature, it is called what?

options.B: Conditional life

explanation: "The stage in which the consciousness of the living entity is attracted by the three modes of material nature is called conditional life." (SB 3.25.15)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Perfection in self-realization cannot be attained by any yogi unless he engages in what?

options.B: Mental speculation
options.C: Devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead

explanation: "Perfection in self-realization cannot be attained by any kind of yogi unless he engages in devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, for that is the only auspicious path." (SB 3.25.19)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Material attachment, when applied to the self-realized devotees, does what?

options.B: Opens the door of liberation

explanation: "But that same attachment, when applied to the self-realized devotees, opens the door of liberation." (SB 3.25.20)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: What are the symptoms of a sadhu, according to Lord Kapila?

options.B: Tolerant, merciful and friendly to all living entities

explanation: "The symptoms of a sadhu are that he is tolerant, merciful and friendly to all living entities." (SB 3.25.21)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Why do the sadhus not suffer from material miseries?

options.B: Because they are always filled with thoughts of the Lord's pastimes and activities
options.C: Because they live in the forest

explanation: "The sadhus do not suffer from material miseries because they are always filled with thoughts of My pastimes and activities." (SB 3.25.23)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: According to Kapila, what is the easiest process of mystic power?

options.B: Mental speculation

explanation: "This process of Krsna consciousness is the easiest process of mystic power; when one is actually situated on that path of devotional service, he is able to control the mind." (SB 3.25.26)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Kapila describes the Sankhya system of philosophy as what?

options.B: Karma and jnana
options.D: A combination of devotional service and mystic realization

explanation: "He described the Sankhya system of philosophy, which is a combination of devotional service and mystic realization, as received by disciplic succession." (SB 3.25.31)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: What does bhakti, devotional service, do to the subtle body of the living entity?

options.B: Dissolves it without separate effort, just as fire in the stomach digests all that we eat
options.D: Transforms it into a spiritual body

explanation: "Bhakti, devotional service, dissolves the subtle body of the living entity without separate effort, just as fire in the stomach digests all that we eat." (SB 3.25.33)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Does a pure devotee attached to the Lord's service ever desire to become one with the Lord?

options.B: Only at the time of death
options.C: Never desires to become one with Me
options.D: Only if the Lord orders it

explanation: "A pure devotee... never desires to become one with Me." (SB 3.25.34)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: When devotees accept the Lord as their friend, relative, son, preceptor, benefactor and Supreme Deity, what is the result?

options.B: They cannot be deprived of their possessions at any time

explanation: "Because the devotees accept Me as their friend, their relative, their son, preceptor, benefactor and Supreme Deity, they cannot be deprived of their possessions at any time." (SB 3.25.38)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Out of fear of whom do the wind, sun, Indra, fire and death perform their functions?

options.B: The Supreme Lord (Kapila)

explanation: "It is because of My supremacy that the wind blows, out of fear of Me; the sun shines out of fear of Me." (SB 3.25.42)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: According to Lord Kapila, what is the only means for attainment of the final perfection of life?

options.B: Complete meditation
options.C: The intensive practice of devotional service

explanation: "Therefore persons whose minds are fixed on the Lord engage in the intensive practice of devotional service. That is the only means for attainment of the final perfection of life." (SB 3.25.44)

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Lord Kapila explained the path of the transcendentalists to His mother as __________.

options.A: He was very keen to deliver her
options.B: A duty towards His mother
options.C: She had uncontaminated desire for transcendental realization

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: The symptoms of a sadhu are __________.

options.B: Peaceful and sublime

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: Sankhya philosophy is __________.

options.B: Combination of devotional service and mystic realization

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: When the devotees accept Lord as their __________, they are not deprived of their possessions.

options.B: Benefactor

subtopic: Ch 25: The Glories of Devotional Service
question: The only means of attaining perfection of life is __________.

options.A: Engage in intensive practice of devotional service
options.B: Know Sankhya philosophy very well
options.C: Be completely engaged in mystic Yoga

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: Kapila says that knowing the different categories of the Absolute Truth releases a person from what?

options.B: The influence of the modes of material nature

explanation: "I shall describe unto you the different categories of the Absolute Truth, knowing which any person can be released from the influence of the modes of material nature." (SB 3.26.1)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: According to Kapila, what is the ultimate perfection of self-realization?

options.B: Renunciation

explanation: "Knowledge is the ultimate perfection of self-realization." (SB 3.26.2)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: Why is the Supreme Personality of Godhead perceivable everywhere?

options.B: Because He is self-effulgent
options.D: Because of the modes of nature

explanation: "He is perceivable everywhere because He is self-effulgent, and by His self-effulgent luster the entire creation is maintained." (SB 3.26.3)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: As His pastime, what did the Supreme Personality of Godhead accept?

options.A: The subtle material energy, invested with three material modes of nature
options.B: A material body

explanation: "That Supreme Personality of Godhead, the greatest of the great, accepted the subtle material energy, which is invested with three material modes of nature and which is related with Visnu." (SB 3.26.4)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: What is the cause of one's conditional life?

options.B: God consciousness

explanation: "Material consciousness is the cause of one's conditional life, in which conditions are enforced upon the living entity by the material energy." (SB 3.26.7)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: Devahuti asks Kapila to explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, because both are the causes of what?

options.B: The living entities only

explanation: "Kindly explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, for both of these are the causes of this manifest and unmanifest creation." (SB 3.26.9)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes, the cause of the manifest state, is called what?

options.B: Pradhana

explanation: "The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes is the cause of the manifest state and is called pradhana." (SB 3.26.10)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: How many elements are included in the pradhana as described by Kapila?

options.B: The five gross, five subtle, four internal senses, five knowledge-gathering senses and five organs of action

explanation: "The aggregate elements, namely the five gross elements, the five subtle elements, the four internal senses, the five senses for gathering knowledge and the five outward organs of action, are known as the pradhana." (SB 3.26.11)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: The mixing element, known as time, is counted as which element?

options.B: The twenty-fourth element

explanation: "The mixing element, which is known as time, is counted as the twenty-fifth element." (SB 3.26.15)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: When the neutral, unmanifested nature is agitated, who is the time factor that causes creation to begin?

options.B: The Supreme Personality of Godhead

explanation: "The time factor, as I have explained, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, from whom the creation begins as a result of the agitation of the neutral, unmanifested nature." (SB 3.26.17)

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature

question: The threefold ahankara (false ego), the source of the gross elements, senses and mind, is known by what name?

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature

options.B: Aniruddha

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature

question: When egoism in ignorance is agitated by the sex energy of the Lord, which subtle element is manifested first?

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature

subtopic: Ch 26: Fundamental Principles of Material Nature
question: When did the Cosmic Being (virat-purusa) finally arise from the causal waters?

options.D: When the sun-god entered His eyes

explanation: "When the inner controller, the deity presiding over consciousness, entered the heart with reason, at that very moment the Cosmic Being arose from the causal waters." (SB 3.26.70)

question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.B: Mode of goodness

question: However advanced a man is, if he is not fixed in Krishna Consciousness, he will simply accept and reject and will never be able to fix his ____ on a particular subject matter.

options.B: Body

question: Although abiding in a material body, the living entity remains apart from the reactions of the modes, similar to what?

options.B: The sun remaining aloof from its reflection on water

explanation: "He remains apart from the reactions of the modes, although abiding in a material body, just as the sun remains aloof from its reflection on water." (SB 3.27.1)

question: When the soul identifies his body as the self under the spell of false ego, what does he think?

options.A: That he is the proprietor of everything
options.B: That he is a servant of God

explanation: "By the influence of false ego he thinks that he is the proprietor of everything." (SB 3.27.2)

question: Why does the conditioned soul transmigrate into different species of life, higher and lower?

options.A: Because of his association with the modes of material nature
options.B: By the will of the demigods

explanation: "The conditioned soul therefore transmigrates into different species of life, higher and lower, because of his association with the modes of material nature." (SB 3.27.3)

question: Although a living entity is transcendental to material existence, why does his material condition not cease?

options.B: Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature

explanation: "Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages." (SB 3.27.4)

question: It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness in what?

options.B: Mental speculation
options.C: Very serious devotional service with detachment

explanation: "It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness, which is now attached to material enjoyment, in very serious devotional service with detachment." (SB 3.27.5)

question: In executing devotional service, how should one see every living entity?

options.B: Equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections

explanation: "In executing devotional service, one has to see every living entity equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections with anyone." (SB 3.27.7)

question: How should a devotee see his own self upon realizing freedom from false ego?

options.A: Just as he sees the sun in the sky
options.B: As a reflection in water

explanation: "Thus realizing freedom from false ego, one should see his own self just as he sees the sun in the sky." (SB 3.27.10)

question: Though a devotee appears merged in the material elements and senses, he is understood to be awake and freed from what?

options.B: Pride

explanation: "He is understood to be awake and to be freed from the false ego." (SB 3.27.14)

question: Devahuti inquires: since material nature and the spirit soul are attracted to one another eternally, how is what possible?

options.B: Their separation

explanation: "Since one is attracted to the other eternally, how is their separation possible?" (SB 3.27.17)

question: How can a living entity get liberation, according to Kapila's answer to Devahuti?

options.B: By acquiring jnana
options.C: By seriously discharging devotional service unto Me

explanation: "One can get liberation by seriously discharging devotional service unto Me and thereby hearing for a long time about Me or from Me." (SB 3.27.21)

question: The influence of material nature can be removed by serious devotional service, just as what happens to the wooden sticks that cause a fire?

options.B: They are themselves consumed by it

explanation: "This influence can be removed, just as wooden sticks which cause a fire are themselves consumed by it." (SB 3.27.23)

question: By giving up his desire to lord it over material nature, the living entity becomes independent and does what?

options.B: Stands in his own glory

explanation: "By therefore giving it up, the living entity becomes independent and stands in his own glory." (SB 3.27.24)

question: Why cannot the influence of material nature harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities?

options.A: Because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Lord
options.B: Because he avoids all activity
options.D: Because he lives in the forest

explanation: "The influence of material nature cannot harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities, because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.27.26)

question: After the mystic devotee gives up his present material body and goes to the transcendental abode, what happens?

options.B: He never comes back
options.C: He returns after a long time

explanation: "After giving up the present material body, the mystic devotee goes to that transcendental abode and never comes back." (SB 3.27.28-29)

question: When a perfect yogi's attention is no longer attracted to the by-products of mystic powers, what cannot overcome him?

options.B: Disease

explanation: "His progress towards Me becomes unlimited, and thus the power of death cannot overcome him." (SB 3.27.30)

question: The by-products of mystic powers are described as manifestations of what?

options.B: The marginal energy

explanation: "The by-products of mystic powers, which are manifestations of the external energy." (SB 3.27.30)

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: One should be satisfied with as much gain as one achieves by the grace of the Lord, and one should worship what?

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: After withdrawing the senses from sense objects, where should the yogi concentrate the mind?

options.B: On the heart

explanation: "One must observe silence, acquire steadiness by practicing different yogic postures, control the breathing of the vital air, withdraw the senses from sense objects and thus concentrate the mind on the heart." (SB 3.28.5)

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: Fixing the vital air and the mind in one of how many circles of vital air circulation is called samadhi?

options.B: Four

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: By practicing pranayama, one can eradicate the contamination of what?

options.B: His mind only

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: By meditating on the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one can become free from what?

options.B: The three modes of material attachment

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: How is the body of the Supreme Personality of Godhead described in the meditation Kapila teaches?

options.B: Swarthy like the petals of a blue lotus

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: On His breast the Lord bears which mark?

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service

options.C: View only the form as a whole

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: The holy waters of the Ganges, borne on Lord Siva's head, have their source in what?

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: The pearl necklace on the Lord's neck is considered to represent whom?

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: When the mind is completely freed from material contamination and detached, what is it compared to?

question: The perfectly realized soul discovers that pleasure and pain are actually due to what?

subtopic: Ch 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service
question: A yogi should see the same soul in all manifestations because all that exists is what?

subtopic: Ch 29: Explanation of Devotional Service by Lord Kapila
question: Devahuti requests Kapila to explain the path of devotional service, which is described as what?

options.B: One of many equal paths
